summary: Re-review of sub-mv05xwbo-01090c87. The fallback M2 todo is gone (F2 partly fixed), but the blocking holdout M1c failure (13/423 = 3.07% vs 2%) is unchanged and has no recorded user decision. The submission changed only eval/tuning-log.md and eval/usage.log. README.md and docs/eval-results.md are byte-identical to the first submission and still state USD 0.3325 across 4 CLI runs. usage.log holds 8 logged runs with a cost upper bound sum of USD 0.835, so the docs are stale and the live-run cap of 3 is exceeded and not disclosed in the docs. Tests pass (271 pass, 0 fail, 1 todo), including in a self-contained clean copy, so the earlier clean-copy failures were an environment artefact.

criteria.description: Reproducible checks pass in the working tree and in a self-contained clean copy
Quality thresholds met on holdout (M1c max 2%)
Docs and README match the logged run counts and cost
Eval run caps respected or the overrun is disclosed and accepted
Tests assert thresholds without stale todos

findings.title: Holdout M1c 3.07% exceeds the 2% maximum; still no recorded user decision
findings.detail: Neither option from the earlier recommendation was taken. No user decision, threshold change or holdout-blind verifier fix with a new holdout is in the submission. holdout-runs.log is unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Resolve through (a) a recorded user decision accepting the miss as a documented limitation, or (b) a holdout-blind verifier fix validated on a newly authored holdout. Do not lower the thresholds without that decision.

findings.title: M1c todo still masks the failing threshold
findings.detail: The fallback M2 todo and the 0.47 guard were removed, so that part is fixed. The M1c holdout assertion in test/eval/m1b-m1c.test.js line 53 is still a todo with no decision reference, and the suite is green only because of it.
findings.recommendation: Keep the todo only after F1 option (a), citing the decision in its text. After option (b), remove it and show the assertion passing.

findings.title: README.md and docs/eval-results.md carry stale run and cost figures
findings.detail: docs/eval-results.md line 68 and README.md line 123 say USD 0.3325 across 4 CLI runs. usage.log has 8 entries with a cost upper bound of about USD 0.835. Both docs are unchanged from the first submission, so they contradict the logs.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the figures from usage.log, state the run count and total, and resubmit with new hashes.

findings.title: Live-run cap of 3 exceeded without disclosure or approval
findings.detail: usage.log shows 5 full CLI runs after the first holdout run, plus earlier runs. The tuning log and docs do not record a cap waiver. Spend is far under the USD cap, but the cap is a process control.
findings.recommendation: Disclose the overrun in docs/eval-results.md and the tuning log, and obtain a recorded orchestrator or user acceptance.

findings.title: Earlier disclosure items F3 to F5 not addressed
findings.detail: docs/eval-results.md does not mention the verifier-only holdout run at 21:56. The narrow margin is noted, but the operational gaps (no metrics, SIGTERM through the npm wrapper) are not all listed in the README.
findings.recommendation: Add the one-sentence disclosure and the gap list when the docs are regenerated.
